Week 2: Performance & Cost (2 half-days + lab: batching/cache tuning + quantization tradeoffs)
Week 3: Integrations & Troubleshooting (2 half-days + lab: observability + rollouts)
Week 4: Exam + capstone (co-branded, remote proctored)

Eve / team — happy to take point on the curriculum. A few clarifications and commitments from Redwood:

- Curriculum format: 6 instructor-led half-days (12 total hours) + 4 hands-on labs + 1 capstone project and exam
- Pass criteria: 70% on written assessment OR successful capstone deploy to staging with checklist items completed
- Co-branding: We can produce co-branded slide deck and a "Brightway + Redwood" partner badge for graduates.
- Demo environment: we'll provision Dedicated-staging; limited to 6 concurrent seats — we recommend running cohorts of 6-8 integrators.

I've attached the first draft of the certification pathways doc (SI_Cert_Pathways_v1.pdf) and an editable training calendar (training-schedule.xlsx). Those include sample lab tasks and a proposed rubric.

Next steps I propose:
1) Brightway confirms cohort size + target start week (we have capacity starting Apr 26)
2) Redwood schedules a 30-min curriculum alignment call (SE + enablement + ops)
3) We finalize exam rubric and PR requirements for badge issuance

Happy to hop on a call — available Thu/Fri this week after 1pm PT.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
